4 Operations on THH of O-algebras

The goal of this section is to initiate the study of endomorphisms of THH viewed as a functor Algo (Catperf) → Sp, that is, to study the extra operations that arise on THH(C) when C has a particular kind of multiplicative structure encoded by a one-colored ∞o-operad O. Our main result in this section is Theorem B. As is clear from the statement of Theorem B, the case of endomorphisms of THH viewed as a functor on Algo (Catperf) is more subtle. We first describe the general approach to this question, and then specialize to get the precise results that we claimed. We let U : Algo (Catperf) → Catperf denote the forgetful functor, with a left adjoint F such that UF ~ On (O(n) & (-)r)hEn [Lur12, Proposition 3.1.3.13].
